content:
olive: FYI i'm opening a small docs PR to add an 'Airgap installer: KMS network policy + Rust SDK example' section. Goal: a Kubernetes NetworkPolicy snippet for clusters that restrict egress to the KMS proxy, a tiny Rust https proxy check, and SNAT notes. Need infra + security review.

pranay: drop the PR link when ready. also call out any env var renames or systemd/unit changes so release notes can track them.

olive: PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342 (draft). Changes: add NetworkPolicy example restricting egress to `kms-proxy.namespace.svc.cluster.local`, add Rust SDK health check snippet using reqwest, include iptables + nft SNAT examples, and a short MTU/fragmentation troubleshooting line for HSM UDP paths. I plan to rename OLD_KMS_PROXY to KMS_PROXY_URL and add TLS_CA_PATH env var.

security: include guidance on storing TLS_CA_PATH in sealed secrets or the platform's KMS. Also add a note about client cert rotation and where to log rotation events.

pranay: good. for NetworkPolicy can you include both a permissive and a default-deny example so customers with different CNI plugins can adapt? mention that some CNIs ignore egress policies for hostNetwork pods.

olive: adding two NetworkPolicy examples. snippet below (minimal):
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-kms-proxy-egress
  namespace: redwood
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redwood-installer
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          name: kms-proxy
      podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 3128
```

olive: Rust snippet (tiny using reqwest):
```rust
// minimal proxy check
let proxy = std::env::var("HTTPS_PROXY").unwrap_or_default();
let client = reqwest::Client::builder().proxy(reqwest::Proxy::http(&proxy).unwrap()).build()?;
let res = client.get("https://kms.internal/healthz").send().await?;
println!("status: {}", res.status());
```

lint-bot: code-fence lint: please mark yaml and rust fences (done). link-checker: found one broken anchor in /installers/airgap.md -> #old-proxy-config. Suggested update: /private/kms-proxy.md#env-vars.

ops-oncall: note on MTU: some HSMs use UDP for certain flows; when SNATting packets get fragmented and dropped. Recommend trying `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400` on egress node as a troubleshooting step. Also include a small iptables/nft example for SNAT.

olive: adding iptables/nft examples and a short 'what to verify' checklist for support: 1) installer logs show "kms: key fetch succeeded", 2) grepping for "handshake" errors, 3) confirm proxy handshake with curl or Rust snippet. Also adding rollback step: unset KMS_PROXY_URL and restart installer service.

security: please add a sentence that env vars that contain sensitive paths should not be logged and instruct on redacting them from support bundles.

pranay: split PR into two commits: (A) NetworkPolicy + snippets + troubleshooting, (B) link fixes + deprecation/migration notes. Tagging @security and @ops-oncall for reviews.

olive: thanks all, i'll mark ready for review after addressing the link-checker suggestion and adding the sealed-secrets note. tagging reviewers in the PR. :white_check_mark:
